verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a dedicated test environment for testing full client- and server-side integrations with test credentials before going live. Its agent-facing surfaces target that environment explicitly: the MCP server runs with `--env=TEST` versus `--env=LIVE`, and the Product Feed API has separate test and live base URLs. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that test-environment data is fully isolated from production accounts and data, detail on simulating specific outcomes in the test environment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: We recommend testing your full integration, including the client-side and server-side parts, in your test environment before accepting live payments.
Test the different types of transactions with Adyen that your integration handles using test credentials.
